# Policy comparison tables (generated by scripts/08_mvp_outputs.py)

All emission numbers are **model-based counterfactual estimates**: simulated household demand under each schedule x realised NESO average carbon intensity, relative to the historical TOU schedule on the same days. Reduction (%) = 100 x (E_hist - E_policy) / E_hist (positive = fewer emissions). Test window Nov-Dec 2013 (61 days). Price target 13.608 p/kWh (historical TOU average over train+val); historical TOU over the test window: 12.795 p/kWh. 95% intervals: 200-draw weekly-block bootstrap of the demand model (policies held fixed).
